OpenAI's coding-performance comparisons and lower-cost positioning remain vendor claims."},{"card_ids":["C03","C04"],"headline":"Pi adds MCP alongside JavaScript-based tool orchestration","supported_fact":"Earendil's author describes Pi's MCP support and JavaScript-based tool orchestration; adoption and reliability gains are not established."},{"card_ids":["C05","C06"],"headline":"Open benchmark collects Opus 5.5 baseline without regression verdict","supported_fact":"The repository reports baseline collection; its maintainers have not reached a performance-regression verdict."},{"card_ids":["C07","C08"],"headline":"OpenAI gradually rolls out reusable Codex cloud environments","supported_fact":"OpenAI documents prepared, reusable cloud environments for coding tasks that continue across devices, with access rolling out gradually."},{"card_ids":["C09","C10"],"headline":"Anthropic reports open-weight model developed end-to-end exploits in evaluation","supported_fact":"Anthropic's evaluation reports end-to-end exploit development by an open-weight model; the findings were not independently reproduced."},{"card_ids":["C11","C12"],"headline":"OpenAI announces staged rollout of cloud agents across connected apps","supported_fact":"OpenAI announced cloud-based agents using cloud computers for work across connected apps, with a staged rollout."},{"card_ids":["C13"],"headline":"Hypothetical: OpenAI later changes GPT-6.1 Sol API pricing","supported_fact":"This fixture describes a hypothetical API pricing change one month after launch, distinct from the launch and Copilot availability."},{"card_ids":["C14"],"headline":"Hypothetical: Pi later patches MCP connector security bug","supported_fact":"This fixture describes a hypothetical security patch two months after MCP support launched, distinct from the support announcement."}]}
